provenance: Written 2026-10-22 for `scripts/local_model.py classify`, to test the export review's two questions on a small model before the judgement gate is built on them: who a memory is about, and which of the person's kept-out items it mentions in its set. Every person, detail and set below is invented for the test and describes no real person. `expect` is what a correct reader answers; the routing rule in `documents/design/export-review.md` turns it into flag or clear. Memories with a sensitive detail in a later sentence, and the softened "medical appointment", are the cases served text alone let through. Its `groups` section holds realistic review groups, added 2026-10-23. Its `p` memories, added 2026-10-25 for `classify --says`, test whether a sentence about a person reports or judges, an LLM counted as a person, and the keep-outs that apply to someone else.

groups.provenance: Added 2026-10-23. Realistic review groups: several ordinary memories on one subject, with one or two carrying a detail after an unremarkable opening, the shape the one-memory-at-a-time run missed every time. Like the rest of this file, every person and detail is invented. The last group, added the same day, puts details in `why` and `context`, which an export publishes as surely as content, and uses a set the person lists under *Sets I never publish*.

recall tuning.content: Recall returns eight memories by default, because larger pages crowded the context of small models.
The non-match floor is calibrated from a set's own labelled queries once twenty have accumulated.
Decided to cap recall results at eight by default, since larger pages crowded the context. Review of the change waits until next month, because the person is away for their daughter's wedding.
Summary detail returns one line per memory, about a fifth of the size of a full record.
Keyword recall orders by match count and then by id, so a single keyword returns memories in the order they were written.
An already_known list pages past memories the caller holds without removing them from the traversal.

release process.content: Release notes live in a separate file so the README stays short.
Versions follow semantic versioning from 0.1.0, with a beta suffix until the format is stable.
The changelog is written by hand at release time rather than generated from commits. The person drafted this release's entries while recovering from a migraine, so a second read is worthwhile.
A release is tagged only after the full mutation pass reports nothing unexpected.
Binary builds are not published yet; users build from source with cargo.
The project pays for its continuous-integration minutes itself. The person covered last quarter's bill from their own savings after a sponsor withdrew.
